scope: Specified MASt3R OBJECT frontend qualification only, not full RHINO/RePHO/Mundo reproduction.
qualification_gates: 13fixed frames and24ordered adjacent pairs; first compatibility pair included.
One fixed crop/resize rule with exact mapping and all input/model hashes.
Single1080Ti batch1/512, max24forward or30min; first incompatibility/OOM stops, no model/precision/crop/budget fallback.
Object evidence only; background matches cannot establish object motion.
Distributed non-collinear Source-compatible neighborhoods; networkconfidence/mask/cycle consistency not truth.
Repeated-pattern ambiguity, insufficient support or background domination =>UNKNOWN/STOP, no threshold or pair search.
Output raw matches/pointmaps/misses/qualification report; no Native pose update or training.
authorization_boundary: Current no-new-heavyweights restriction requires explicit exception before download/install/inference. Exception does not include training, other models, RePHO stack or automatic later optimization.
